RULE 3: Draft 8 (WaveIO) - Phrase 'a quick check-in from Marcus' in subject line is overly casual and self-referential; should focus on value proposition or next steps

RULE 4: Draft 11 (SwiftSolutions) - Research shows deal is at 10% probability in discovery stage (very low for $75K), yet draft tone is exploratory and assumes deal viability; should be more direct about re-qualification given critical churn signal
